goal: Review and improve code quality in dsh-squad project

tasks.title: Review code quality and identify issues
tasks.description:
Goal: Review the dsh-squad codebase for quality issues

Context:
- Read all TypeScript/JavaScript files in src/ and bin/
- Check for code quality issues
- Identify potential bugs
- Suggest improvements

Output:
- Review report with specific issues
- Recommendations for improvements

Boundaries:
- Read-only review, do NOT modify code
- Focus on correctness and quality

Verify: Review report is complete

## IMPORTANT: End with verdict format:
## Verdict: APPROVE | REQUEST CHANGES
## Issues: (if any)

tasks.title: Perform security audit
tasks.description:
Goal: Identify security vulnerabilities in the codebase

Context:
- Check for common security issues
- Review file handling and permissions
- Look for injection vulnerabilities
- Check for hardcoded secrets

Output:
- Security audit report
- List of vulnerabilities
- Remediation suggestions

Boundaries:
- Read-only audit
- Focus on security issues

Verify: Security report is complete

tasks.title: Fix identified issues
tasks.description:
Goal: Fix issues identified in review and security audit

Context:
- Use reports from review-code and security-audit tasks
- Fix each issue systematically
- Verify fixes work

Output:
- Fixed code
- Updated tests if needed

Boundaries:
- Only fix reported issues
- Maintain existing functionality

Verify: All reported issues are resolved
